friction: buck2 reports 0% cache hits across the board (review-agent throwaway worktrees, ephemeral CI runners, any fresh buck-out). Empirical: in-daemon incrementality works (2nd build same buck-out = nothing to do) but there is NO shared cache, so every fresh buck-out is 100% cold (153 local commands for a tiny target). Compounds: CI actions/cache key embeds github.sha in the PRIMARY key (buck-out-OS-hash-SHA) so the primary key MISSES every commit and each run SAVES a fresh full buck-out cache entry -> cache bloat feeding the runner disk-full failure (FRIC-017).
pipeline_defect: the content-addressed delivery fabric's central premise (a correct cache hit == a cold build, so warm is free) is unrealized: .buckconfig has NO [cache] section, no RBE/NativeLink/HTTP CAS — buck2 caching is local-buck-out-only, never shared across dev machines / CI runners / worktrees. Result is worst-of-both: cold everywhere (no sharing) yet not DELIBERATELY cold (no provenance guarantee, no hermeticity canary) — full cold-build cost paid on every action, everywhere, every time, plus CI cache bloat.
enforcement_fix: WARM-BY-DEFAULT via a shared content-addressed remote cache (NativeLink — Rust, open-source, content-addressed, owned-stack + Rust-purity aligned; or self-hosted HTTP CAS) read/written by ALL actors incl. throwaway review worktrees and ephemeral runners. COLD DELIBERATELY in exactly 3 cases: (1) release-image builds (provenance/reproducibility — the cargo --release exception path, no cache write-back); (2) a periodic COLD-CANARY CI job (full-graph cold build that must byte-match the warm result; cold!=warm = a hermeticity/non-determinism bug, fail closed — this is the cache-integrity gate); (3) trust-boundary: untrusted-author PRs build with READ-ONLY (or no) shared-cache access to prevent cache poisoning (Bazel/Google RBE security model). Also fix the CI key: drop github.sha from the PRIMARY actions/cache key (use restore-keys prefix + the remote cache), killing the per-commit miss + bloat. This is the HANDOFF W3 'buck2 RBE/NativeLink' item; grounded in Bazel Remote Execution + Meta Buck2 RE content-addressed caching.
